facts.text: John decided to act after seeing the effect unemployment has on neighbors.

evidence.quote: Seeing the effect unemployment has on our neighbors made me decide to act.
Unemployment in our community was the reason behind it.

facts.text: John started a community food drive to help those who lost their jobs.

evidence.quote: I wanted to help out in these tough times by doing a community food drive.
We've been overwhelmed by the response and the volunteers.

facts.text: John mentioned a photo of a group of people standing around a table with boxes of tomatoes.

evidence.quote: Here's a photo of me at the food bank.
Here's a photo of a large group of people standing around a table.
